title: Cavern Roar
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A roaring subtractive supersaw pad detuned into a thick wall that growls from sub-register up through the full spectrum on a slow 32-cycle ladder-filter journey. Resonance swells, vibrato deepens, and a phaser breathes while a wide cavernous reverb and long delay tails make it feel like the synth is roaring across an enormous space.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c2 <eb2 g1> <ab1 f1>>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .detune(sine.slow(23).range(0.1, 0.6))
    .off(0.011, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.6))
    .off(0.017, x => x.add(note(-0.1)).gain(0.55))
    .add(note("<0 12>/8"))
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180, 5200)).resonance(sine.slow(19).range(8, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(saw.slow(16).range(1, 4)).lpattack(0.02).lpdecay(0.3).lpsustain(0.5)
    .vib("<3 5 8>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.2, 1.8))
    .phaser(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.9)).phaserdepth(0.7)
    .shape(0.32).coarse("<1 1 2>/12")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .attack(0.02).decay(0.3).sustain(0.7).release(0.4)
    .delay("0.45:0.375:0.6").room(0.85).roomsize(8).orbit(2)
    .gain(0.85)
)
